new_libraries.name: Buratino
new_libraries.author: Eugene Pistrak
new_libraries.sentence: Shared building blocks for Arduino libraries: a small array list and a reference-counted pointer.
new_libraries.paragraph: BList works over a fixed array (no heap) or grows on the heap; BPtr is a reference-counted smart pointer. Used by Eventfun, Taskfun and Focuspocus.

new_libraries.name: JoystickUtilities
new_libraries.author: Christoph Streit <christoph.streit@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Read, calibrate and store analog thumb sticks, with direction keys for menus.
new_libraries.paragraph: Maps each axis to -1000..1000 with a dead zone, averaging and optional inversion. Provides the building blocks of a calibration - averaging the resting position, recording the travel while the stick is swept, checking the result per axis - and leaves the procedure (Serial prompts, a display, buttons) to the sketch. Direction keys with auto-repeat turn a stick into up/down/left/right events. Stores calibrations with Preferences on ESP32. Reads physical joysticks; it does not emulate a USB game controller.

library.name: Focuspocus
library.author: glutio
library.sentence: A small GUI framework for Arduino displays: buttons, checkboxes, labels, sliders, layout, focus and touch.
library.paragraph: Static widgets (no heap required), stack-panel layout, screens and popups, touch or button navigation, themes. Draws on any Adafruit_GFX display; a Windows build runs the same code for testing.

library.name: XeWeCore
library.author: Maxim Dokukin
library.sentence: Modular firmware core for ESP32: serial console, command line, typed NVS storage, helpers and a module framework.
library.paragraph: Include <XeWeCore.h> and use the parts on their own (xewe::SerialPort, xewe::Cli, xewe::Nvs) or as a whole through XeWeOs: modules that each own a $group of commands and an NVS namespace, settings declared once as a table, and a JSON settings schema for tools.
